name: Thorium Point
summary: At Thorium Point, the Thorium Brotherhood holds its ground against Dark Iron kin who serve the Firelord and Emperor Dagran Thaurissan. The outpost welcomes Alliance and Horde travelers who will gather ore or fight in the volcanic wastes.

sections.title: A Foothold Above the Ash
sections.body:
Thorium Point clings to the northern bluffs above the scorched slag heaps of the Searing Gorge. The Thorium Brotherhood holds this mountain camp. Its Dark Iron dwarves broke from their enslaved kin in Shadowforge City and refuse to bow to the Firelord or Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

An open-air forge, a busy flight master, and guarded walls give the Brotherhood a foothold northeast of Firewatch Ridge. They struggle to survive and seek mastery of smithing. With few allies, they open the camp to both Alliance and Horde travelers, who can dig ore from the ash or fight the Dark Iron dwarves.

sections.title: A Waystation for Wayfarers
sections.body:
Thorium Point gives the Brotherhood a base for war against its kin and a safe crossing through the Redridge mountain chain. The camp overlooks a volcanic basin where ravenous spiders and fire elementals prowl.

Flight links reach Ironforge and forward camps across the Badlands and the Burning Steppes. Mercenaries, prospectors, and crafters seeking the secret favor of master dwarf smiths find a safe hearth on this smoky cliffside.

faq.answer: The Thorium Brotherhood controls Thorium Point. Its Dark Iron dwarves broke away from their fiery emperor and seek to live free of elemental servitude.

faq.q: Why is Thorium Point neutral to both the Alliance and Horde?
aliases: why can horde use thorium point
faq.answer: The Thorium Brotherhood faces more hostile Dark Iron kin and beasts than it can fight alone. It trades freely and hires adventurers from either faction because it cannot afford more enemies.

faq.q: What services are available at Thorium Point?
faq.answer: Thorium Point has flight masters with links to Ironforge, the Badlands, and the Burning Steppes. Trade vendors, a working forge and anvil, and local work against the Dark Iron dwarves are also available.

faq.q: Where is Thorium Point located in Searing Gorge?
faq.answer: Thorium Point lies high along Searing Gorge's northern rock wall, northeast of Firewatch Ridge, overlooking the caldera floor.

angles.text: Dark Iron smiths at Thorium Point keep trade secrets coveted by metalworkers across the world. They offer rare plans to crafters who bring volcanic ore and components.
As a dwarf, you may rarely meet Dark Iron dwarves who do not try to kill you. Bronzebeard travelers know these outcasts are driven by craft and survival, not love for Ironforge.
